app.run: The app is the MakeCode editor for the Calliope mini, served locally by `pxt serve` (the global `pxt` CLI is installed; it uses this workspace's `node_modules/pxt-core`). Run `npm install` once per workspace. Port 3232/3233 belongs to the owner's main checkout (and the campus embed), so pick a free pair of your own, e.g. 3242/3243 (check with `netstat -ano | findstr :3242`), and start in the workspace root, in the background: `pxt serve --noBrowser --noauth --port 3242 --wsport 3243`. Right after it listens, write the port into `built/obeya-serve-port` (e.g. `echo 3242 > built/obeya-serve-port`): Obeya's stop command reads it. The first start builds the target, libs and simulator and takes a few minutes; it is ready once the console prints "Server listening on port 3242" and the launch URL. Open `http://localhost:3242/` (with `--noauth` no local_token is needed). There is no login and no test data: on the home screen, "New Project" asks for a name ("Create"), then for the board ("Calliope mini 3"); the blocks editor opens with the simulator on the left (close the "Welcome!" tour bubble with its x), and dragging e.g. "show icon" from "Basic" into "on start" shows it on the simulated Calliope mini at once. Projects are kept in the browser's IndexedDB. After a change to `sim/`, `editor/`, `fieldeditors/`, `theme/` or `libs/`, the running server rebuilds by itself (watch the console until it is done), then reload the page; after a change to `pxtarget.json`, `targetconfig.json` or `package.json`, stop and start `pxt serve` again. To try the editor embedded in Calliope Campus, start campus with `PUBLIC_MAKECODE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3242/index.html`; the IoT dashboard panel beside the simulator additionally needs pxt-iot-sim (`npm run dev` in `D:\GIT\calliope-dev\editors\pxt-iot-sim`, fixed port 3400, so only one at a time). If the build is in a bad state, `pxt clean` and start again. Stop it afterwards by its PID (`netstat -ano | findstr :3242`, then `taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F`), never by name: other workspaces run their own `pxt serve`. `pxt serve` writes ignored build output only (`built/`, `libs/*/built/`, `_locales`); if `git status` shows changed tracked files after a run that you did not make, restore them before committing.
app.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f='built/obeya-serve-port'; if (Test-Path $f) { $p=[int](Get-Content $f); Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { taskkill /PID $_.OwningProcess /T /F | Out-Null }; Remove-Item $f }"
